name: 三国志MUD
english_name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms MUD (sgz snapshot)
english_description: A year-2000 Lima-mudlib Three Kingdoms game from the sgz/lib tree of archive 145. Distinct from the later GitHub sanguozhi snapshot (162). Runs on the shared default FluffOS (no ARRAY_RESERVED_WORD). New players start in 华阴草庐 (/a/huayin/vhall) with water-mirror NPC, a village map, nations, troops and historical horses.
